|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-ds615.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-ds615-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-ds615-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-ds615-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-ds615.gif]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
